name: adr183-continuation-native-15
result: The continuation completed natively with ADR-184/185/186: public sources, all 66 public runtime roles (2 min 56 s), the public projection verified and published in one role operation (3.5 s), owner identity roles (now six purposes), selection, provider artifact with applier and owner projection and launch.
